# Eyob Zeray

## My Name

## My Favourite Sport
Football. I have loved football since childhood — both watching and playing it.

## My Favourite Food
My favourite food is Tsebhi Doro, a traditional dish from my home country. 
It is a rich and flavourful chicken stew that holds a special place in my heart. 
Every bite reminds me of home and family.
